flow.name: axn-term - image dropped on the terminal is pasted as its path
flow.description: Drag a PNG from a file-manager stand-in onto axn-term with real X11 drag and drop, as when dropping a screenshot into Claude Code. The webview must not open the image in place of the app; the terminal must get the image's path at the prompt; the app's own drags (a session row onto another workspace) must still work; the window must still close from its close button. Runs on a private X server (Xvfb, else rootful Xwayland), so the desktop never sees the input.

script.description: Create temp state: one window, one plain shell session
Start a private X server with a drag source holding 'drop image.png'
Launch axn-term on the test display
Drop on the session panel: nothing is typed and the app stays loaded
Type 'wc -c ', drop on the terminal, press Enter: the shell counts the image's bytes
Drag the session row onto the empty 'extra' workspace with the mouse: the app's own drags still work beside the native file-drop handler
Press the window's close button and confirm: the app exits

assert.value: dropped image pasted as its path
session row dragged to another workspace
window closed by its close button
